name: Feature proposal
about: Propose a useful capability without committing to implementation

---

Use synthetic or general examples, not personal records. Suggestions start discussion; they do not authorize implementation or data access. Plain language and incomplete ideas are welcome.

## Motivation and intended behaviour
Whose problem would this solve? What attention or effort could it save?

## Evidence and assumptions
What observations support the idea? What could disprove the assumptions?

## Alternatives
Include a simpler approach or no change.

## Affected modules and risks
Unknown is fine. Consider privacy, accessibility, security, maintenance and human attention. Preserve non-actuation.

## Acceptance criteria and unresolved questions
How could we tell whether it helped? What remains uncertain?
